turns.prompt: psat.DSC/.DTA is a 2D CW-EPR power-saturation series of a spin label: the second axis is the microwave attenuation in dB, with 200 mW at 0 dB. Fit the centre-line peak-to-peak amplitude A(P) = I sqrt(P) [1 + (2^(1/eps) - 1) P/P_half]^(-eps) and report the half-saturation power in mW (P_half_mW) and eps (epsilon).
